Planned experiment

Living Through History

A learning system will be placed at the start of a historical timeline, and each piece of information will be revealed only when it would have become available at the time. The first environment is planned to be the financial market from about 1900 onwards. Price prediction is only one part of the test. In addition, the system must make decisions, keep a view of the world, revise earlier beliefs and continue learning, all without access to later data. The experiment has not started yet.
